answer: Clone crews plant many cairns on one dune to claim extra concession payouts from one traverse. Each identity opens only one concession: lock 36.5 POA at cairn CR-9 on dune DG-14, seat an 88 g onyx disc (one-time serial) in marble plinth slot PL-3, and finish a 40-minute walk hashing bearings 18°, 97°, 204°, and 311° with that serial. Peers recompute the hash; a reused serial is rejected. If a second identity offers the same disc or bearing string inside 14h, both stakes are slashed 60% and PL-3 seals for 3 epochs. A walk over 40 minutes refunds the stake minus 2.0 POA and issues no right.
